text: Write a C function to find all adverbs and their positions in a given sentence by using regex.

args: Clearly, he has no excuse for such behavior.
test_cases.assert_src: assert find_adverbs("Clearly, he has no excuse for such behavior.") == '0-7: Clearly'
assert find_adverbs("Please handle the situation carefuly") == '28-36: carefuly'
assert find_adverbs("Complete the task quickly") == '18-25: quickly'
